heading: Configured swarms

label: Agent swarm enabled
description: Master switch of the Agent swarm add-on (on by default). Configuration file only.

heading: Score and runs
label: Score and runs
description: Today's score overall and for Learn, Check and Guard, with the last measurement or cycle.

heading: Score and runs
label: Measure
description: Runs every usable task on the model to see how it does today. Makes one model call per task and run.

heading: Score and runs
label: Run a cycle
description: The reviewer studies failures on Learn tasks and proposes small changes, each tested on Check and Guard tasks. Needs a model, a reviewer and tasks in all three groups.

heading: Score and runs
label: Stop
description: Stops a measurement or cycle that is running. Shown only while one runs.

heading: Changes waiting for you
label: Changes waiting for you
description: Proposed changes that passed the gates and wait for your decision. Shown only when there are some.

heading: Changes waiting for you
label: Approve and use
description: Approves a proposed change; it is in use at once.

heading: Changes waiting for you
label: Decline
description: Declines a proposed change.

heading: Setup
label: Setup
description: What to improve, the reviewer and judge models, and a run's limits.

heading: Setup
label: Use self-improvement
description: Off stops runs and adds nothing to any conversation.

heading: Setup
label: What to improve
description: A saved model version (from Settings → Model Tiers → Model versions) or a plain model. Each has its own tasks, lessons and history.

heading: Setup
label: Model to improve
description: Usually a local model. The test tasks run on it, and approved lessons are used in every conversation. Shown when "A plain model" is chosen.

heading: Setup
label: Reviewer model
description: A stronger model. It sees the Learn tasks, the answers and why they failed, with secrets, addresses and home paths removed. It never sees your conversations.

heading: Setup
label: Judge model (optional)
description: Only for tasks with a "judge" check. Without it, such a check never counts as passed.

heading: Setup
label: Use approved instructions in real conversations
description: Off keeps them to test runs only, so you can try the loop without changing how the app behaves.

heading: Setup
label: Runs per task
description: A model does not answer the same way twice. More runs give a steadier score and cost more. 1 to 5.

heading: Setup
label: Changes tried per cycle
description: Each one is tested on its own, so a gain can be traced to one change. 1 to 5.

heading: Setup
label: Token allowance per run
description: A run stops when it has used this many tokens, and changes nothing. 0 means no limit.

heading: Tasks
label: Tasks
description: Test tasks from your own work, each with checks, in three groups: Learn, Check and Guard. The heading shows how many there are.

heading: Tasks
label: Add example tasks
description: Opens the example sets: hard, ready-made tasks per kind of work (reasoning, code, structured output, writing, tool use and more). Tick the sets you want.

heading: Tasks
label: New task
description: Opens the form for a new test task.

heading: Tasks
label: Example tasks
description: The example sets with a tick box each; each set is spread over Learn, Check and Guard. Shown after Add example tasks.

heading: Tasks
label: Select all
description: Ticks every example set (Clear all unticks them).

heading: Tasks
label: Add ticked
description: Adds the tasks of the ticked example sets.

heading: Tasks
label: Remove ticked
description: Removes the example tasks of the ticked sets that were added before.

heading: Tasks
label: What to ask the model
description: The task's prompt, written the way you would ask it. In the New task or Edit task form.

heading: Tasks
label: Kind of work (a name of your choice, such as code, writing, research)
description: Groups tasks by kind of work; lessons are kept per kind of work.

heading: Tasks
label: Group
description: Learn (the reviewer studies these), Check (prove a change helps) or Guard (things that must keep working).

heading: Tasks
label: How it runs
description: Answer only (one go, no tools) or With tools: a helper agent works in an empty temporary folder; needs an open Cowork or Code conversation.

heading: Tasks
label: How to tell a good result. Every check must pass.
description: The task's checks: contains, notContains, noneOf, equals, regex, json, wordCount, lineCount, fileExists, fileContains or judge, with what to look for.

heading: Tasks
label: Add a check
description: Adds another check to the task (up to 8).

heading: Tasks
label: Save task
description: Saves the new or edited task.

heading: Tasks
label: Edit
description: Opens a task in the form to change it.

heading: Tasks
label: Delete
description: Deletes a task.

heading: Lessons in use
label: Lessons in use
description: The lessons and instructions in use now, with the active version. Approved changes appear here.

heading: Lessons in use
label: Add a lesson of your own
description: Type a lesson, set its kind of work (all by default) and press Add. It is used at once, without being tested by the gates.

heading: Versions
label: Versions
description: Every version of the lessons, with its score. Any earlier one can be put back.

heading: Versions
label: Use this version
description: Puts an earlier version back in use.

heading: Earlier proposals
label: Earlier proposals
description: Earlier proposed changes: approved, declined, stopped by the gates or out of date.

heading: How it works
label: How it works
description: What it can change, what a change must pass, what leaves this Mac, and what it cannot do.

label: Answer length ceiling
description: How much longer answers may get before a change is refused (1.5 = 50% more tokens). Configuration file only.

label: Data folder
description: Where tasks, versions and results are kept; by default a folder in the dsh home. Configuration file only.

label: Slash command name
description: Name of the /evolve command; empty registers none. Configuration file only.

heading: Alert me when
label: Alert me when
description: Which events about tasks send an alert.

heading: Alert me when
label: A task failed or was stopped
description: Alert when a task fails or is stopped. On by default.

heading: Alert me when
label: A task needs me
description: It waits for your approval, your answer to a question, or your review of its plan.

heading: Alert me when
label: A task finished
description: Alert when a task finishes. Off by default.

heading: For which tasks
label: For which tasks
description: Scheduled tasks always alert; conversations you start yourself can too.

heading: For which tasks
label: Scheduled tasks
description: Always, when alerts are on. The alert names the task.

heading: For which tasks
label: Also conversations I start myself
description: The alert names the project folder, not the conversation.

heading: For which tasks
label: Only when the task has run at least this many minutes
description: So that quick answers you are waiting for at your desk stay quiet. 0 alerts every time. Shown when the switch above is on; 2 by default.

heading: Where
label: Where
description: Where alerts appear: on this Mac and on your phone through ntfy.

heading: Where
label: On this Mac
description: A normal notification. The first time, macOS may ask whether "Script Editor" may show notifications: allow it.

heading: Where
label: On my phone
description: Through the free ntfy app. Set up the topic first.

heading: Where
label: Topic
description: The name your phone listens to. Anyone who knows it can read your alerts, so it must be hard to guess.

heading: Where
label: Make one up
description: Fills in a hard-to-guess ntfy topic. Shown while there is no topic.

heading: Where
label: Server
description: Leave this as it is unless you run your own ntfy server. https://ntfy.sh by default.

heading: Where
label: Send a test alert
description: Try it: sends one sample alert to every place that is switched on.

heading: Set up your phone
label: Set up your phone
description: Four steps to get alerts on your phone with the free ntfy app.

heading: Everything
label: Everything
description: The master switch for recording runs and sending alerts.

heading: Everything
label: Record runs and send alerts
description: Off records no runs on the Automation runs page and sends no alerts.

heading: Good to know
label: Good to know
description: Privacy of phone alerts, ntfy limits (250 a day; at most 10 a minute sent), and where the topic is saved.

heading: Preview
label: Preview
description: A live sample of the chosen design, with made-up figures.

heading: Preview
label: Everything at once
description: Picks the sample the preview shows: Reading prompt, Thinking, Writing, Tool call, Web search, Only background work, Everything at once, Waiting for you, Error, Idle.

heading: Look
label: Look
description: How the activity indicator looks.

heading: Look
label: Show the activity indicator
description: Off removes it everywhere.

heading: Look
label: Design
description: Pulse line, Lanes, Threads, Ticker tape, Rings, Pulse line + Ticker tape, or Threads + Rings: above the chat box, beside the model button or on the window edge.

heading: Look
label: Thickness
description: How heavy the lines are: Thin, Normal or Bold.

heading: Look
label: Arrow to fold the message box away
description: Adds a small arrow at the right end of the line. A click folds the message box down so only the line is left; another click brings it back.

heading: Look
label: Fit the message box
description: On keeps the line above the message box exactly as wide as the box, so the two look like one. Off lets it span the whole chat area.

heading: Look
label: Hide when nothing is running
description: Off keeps a faint resting line, so the chat box does not jump.

heading: Look
label: No movement
description: Colour only: nothing flows, spins or pulses.

heading: What to track
label: What to track
description: Which kinds of work the indicator shows, each with a switch and its own colour.

heading: What to track
label: Track everything
description: Switches every kind of work back on.

heading: What to track
label: Prompt processing
description: The model is reading the prompt; no token has come back yet. Has its own colour picker.

heading: What to track
label: Thinking
description: Reasoning tokens are arriving. Has its own colour picker.

heading: What to track
label: Token generation
description: The answer, or the arguments of a tool call, is being written. Has its own colour picker.

heading: What to track
label: Tool calls
description: A tool is running. Has its own colour picker.

heading: What to track
label: Web search
description: A web search or fetch tool is running. Has its own colour picker.

heading: What to track
label: Scripts and commands
description: A shell command or script tool is running. Has its own colour picker.

heading: What to track
label: Sub-agents
description: Helpers of this conversation are working. Has its own colour picker.

heading: What to track
label: Other conversations
description: Another conversation is working. Has its own colour picker.

heading: What to track
label: Waiting for you
description: The app waits for your approval. Everything pulses in this colour. Has its own colour picker.

heading: What to track
label: Errors and retries
description: A turn failed, or the model request is being retried. Everything pulses in this colour. Has its own colour picker.

heading: What to track
label: Use the built-in colours
description: Drops your own colours for the kinds of work. Shown once you have changed a colour.

heading: Sounds
label: Sounds
description: Sounds when the app waits for you or a turn fails.

heading: Sounds
label: Play a sound when it needs you
description: When the app starts waiting for your approval, and when a turn fails. Retries make no sound.

heading: Sounds
label: Volume
description: From barely audible to loud, 0 to 100% (30 by default). Press Try to hear it.

heading: Sounds
label: Sound for "waiting for you"
description: Chime by default. Choices: No sound, Chime, Beep, Double beep, Triple beep, Bell, Ping, Low, Alarm, Siren. Try plays it.

heading: Sounds
label: Sound for an error
description: Low by default. Same choice of sounds; Try plays it.

heading: Sounds
label: Repeat while it still waits
description: Plays the waiting sound again until you answer: Once only, every 10 or 30 seconds, every minute or every 5 minutes.

heading: Text
label: Text
description: The short line of text under the indicator.

heading: Text
label: Show the text
description: A short line that says what is running. It has its own row, so the bar never gets shorter.

heading: Text
label: Figures
description: Tokens per second, seconds and counts.

heading: Text
label: Words, not short codes
description: "Writing" for TG, "Reading prompt" for PP, "Sub-agents" for BG, "Other chats" for OC.

heading: Text
label: Last prompt speed
description: Adds "PP 1,850 t/s" while the model thinks or writes. It is known once the first token arrives.

heading: Text
label: Conversation size
description: Adds "ctx 12.4k": the tokens the last request held.

heading: Ticker tape
label: Ticker tape
description: Settings for the designs with a ticker tape.

heading: Ticker tape
label: History
description: How much time the tape holds from end to end: 1, 2, 5 or 15 minutes.

heading: Ticker tape
label: Solid blocks
description: Off draws separate ticks.

heading: Ticker tape
label: Fade older work
description: The further right, the fainter.

heading: Ticker tape
label: A mark every 10 seconds
description: Draws a mark on the ticker tape every 10 seconds.

heading: Tool names
label: Tool names
description: Which tool names count as web search and as scripts or commands.

heading: Tool names
label: Counts as web search
description: A tool counts when its name contains one of these words, separated by commas. Empty uses the built-in list.

heading: Tool names
label: Counts as a script or command
description: Words, separated by commas; a tool whose name contains one counts as a script or command. Empty uses the built-in list.

label: Slash command name
description: Name of the /activity command; empty registers none. Configuration file only.

label: Notify rules
description: Notify add-on (no settings page): commands to run when a turn ends or dsh waits for your approval. Does nothing until you list a rule. Configuration file only.

label: Notify enabled
description: Master switch of the Notify add-on (on by default). Configuration file only.

label: Notify commands per minute
description: Most Notify commands run in a minute across all rules (20 by default). Configuration file only.

label: Notify slash command name
description: Name of the /notify command (notify by default). Configuration file only.

label: Memory
description: A short list of lasting things the assistant should know about you, given to every new conversation. Nothing is added unless you add it or say yes to a suggestion.

label: Suggested by the assistant
description: Appears only while the assistant has suggested entries to remember. The heading shows how many are waiting, e.g. (2). Save or dismiss each one.

heading: Suggested by the assistant
label: Save
description: Accepts a suggested entry and keeps it in the memory.

heading: Suggested by the assistant
label: No
description: Dismisses a suggested entry without saving it.

label: Add something
description: Type something lasting to remember, choose its group and press Remember.

heading: Add something
label: For example: I am a student, not a programmer. Explain in plain words.
description: The field for what to remember (up to 300 characters). Press Enter or Remember to add it.

heading: Add something
label: About me
description: Group for the new entry; shows the chosen group: About me, How I like answers, Current projects or Other.

heading: Add something
label: Remember
description: Adds the typed entry to the memory in the chosen group.

label: How I like answers
description: Saved entries in the How I like answers group. Shown when the group has entries.

label: Current projects
description: Saved entries in the Current projects group. Shown when the group has entries.

label: Other
description: Saved entries in the Other group. Shown when the group has entries.

label: Still true
description: On an entry older than four months (marked "Is this still true?"): confirms it still holds and clears the mark.

label: Edit
description: On each saved entry: change its text and group, then Save or Cancel.

label: Delete
description: On each saved entry: removes it from the memory.

label: Settings
description: The switches for Memory: whether it is used and whether the assistant may suggest entries.

heading: Settings
label: Use memory
description: Off keeps the list but leaves it out of new conversations.

heading: Settings
label: Let the assistant suggest entries
description: It can only suggest. You decide each time.

label: Good to know
description: Changes apply to new conversations; keep entries lasting; never store passwords or keys; entries older than four months are marked for review.

label: Library
description: Folders of your own documents the assistant may search: readings, papers, notes, slides. It quotes them with file and page. Documents are read on this Mac.

label: Folders
description: The folders in the Library, with how many documents each holds and when it was last read.

heading: Folders
label: Remove
description: On each folder: takes it out of the Library after asking. The folder and its files are not touched; only its index is removed.

heading: Folders
label: A folder, for example ~/Documents/Economics
description: Type the path of a folder to add to the Library, then press Enter or Add.

heading: Folders
label: Add
description: Adds the typed folder to the Library; its documents are read right away.

heading: Folders
label: Choose…
description: Opens the folder chooser to pick a folder to add to the Library.

heading: Folders
label: Check now
description: Checks the folders now for new and changed documents. New and changed files are also picked up by themselves.

label: Try a search
description: Search the Library the way the assistant would, to see what it finds.

heading: Try a search
label: A few words, as the assistant would search
description: Words to test-search the Library with; press Enter or Search. Changes nothing.

label: Could not be searched
description: Appears when some documents could not be read, for example scans with no words found.

label: Settings
description: The switch for the Library.

heading: Settings
label: Use the Library
description: Off takes the search away from the assistant and stops the reading. What was read is kept.

label: Good to know
description: Supported file types, scanned PDFs, word-based search, where the index is kept, and that it works in Cowork and Code tabs.

label: Folder check interval (minutes)
description: How often the folders are checked for new and changed files, in minutes. 0 = only when you press Check now. Default 10. Only in the configuration file.

label: PDF reader
description: Lets the model read PDFs properly: page-numbered text, search, tables in columns, page pictures and text recognition for scans. Uses macOS; nothing leaves this Mac.

label: How to use it
description: Ask about a PDF in the conversation's folder by name, or type /pdf file.pdf. Lists the five PDF tools and the read-pdf skill.

label: Settings
description: The switches and limits for the PDF reader.

heading: Settings
label: Use the PDF reader
description: Off makes the tools answer that they are switched off.

heading: Settings
label: More folders the model may read PDFs from
description: PDFs in the conversation's own folder can always be read. List other folders here, one per line. Sub-folders are included.

heading: Settings
label: Allow any PDF on this Mac
description: Off (recommended) keeps the model to the folders above. On lets it open a PDF at any path you or a document mention.

heading: Settings
label: How much text one read returns
description: A long page range stops at this size and says where to continue: Small, Normal, Large or Very large (about 3,000 to 30,000 tokens).

label: Good to know
description: Complex tables and formulas, how long text and page pictures are kept, and that password-protected PDFs cannot be read.

label: read-pdf skill
description: Register the read-pdf skill. On by default. Only in the configuration file.

label: Slash command name (/pdf)
description: Name of the slash command, default pdf; empty registers none. Only in the configuration file.

label: Code map
description: A compact map of your project so the assistant looks things up and reads one function at a time instead of whole files. Uses far fewer tokens. Nothing is installed.

label: Use the code map
description: Gives the assistant five look-up tools in conversations that have tools (Cowork and Code).

label: Tell the assistant about it
description: Adds three lines to its instructions in code projects, so it uses the map before reading files.

label: Mapped folders
description: Folders that have a map, with files, names, source size, map size and when it was made.

heading: Mapped folders
label: Map this folder now
description: Maps the app's default folder; shown while that folder has no map yet.

heading: Mapped folders
label: Map again
description: On each mapped folder: builds its map again.

heading: Mapped folders
label: Delete map
description: On each mapped folder: deletes its map from the app's data folder. Your project is not touched.

label: Limits
description: How many files are mapped, the largest file size, and extra patterns to leave out.

heading: Limits
label: Most files in one folder
description: A bigger folder is mapped up to this many files. 100 to 50,000.

heading: Limits
label: Largest file (KB)
description: Bigger files are skipped. 16 to 4,096.

heading: Limits
label: Also leave out
description: One pattern per line, like a line in a .gitignore file, e.g. docs/ or *.generated.ts. Dependency and build folders, binaries, lock files and .gitignore entries are always left out.

label: Reverse-engineer skills
description: Four step-by-step guides: /reverse-codebase, /reverse-website, /reverse-api-format and /reverse-app-binary. Type / in the chat box and pick one.

label: Good to know
description: The map holds names, line numbers and connections, not your code; connections come from reading the text; only the conversation's folder is mapped.

label: Map storage folder
description: Where maps are kept; empty uses a folder in the app's data folder. Only in the configuration file.

label: Slash command name (/codemap)
description: Name of the slash command, default codemap; empty registers none. Only in the configuration file.

label: Register the reverse-engineer skills
description: Registers the four reverse-engineer skills. On by default. Only in the configuration file.

label: Learning
description: A tutor that makes you do the thinking: asks before it explains, helps in small steps, gives the answer last, and brings each idea back days later.

label: Your progress
description: Ideas due for review, the share solved without the answer, and how many ideas and topics you studied.

label: Due for review
description: Ideas due for review now. Type /learn review in a conversation to go through them.

label: How to use it
description: Type /learn and a topic, file or code; a study bar with Start, Hint, Show answer and End appears above the chat box.

label: Settings
description: The switch, level and review size for Learning.

heading: Settings
label: Use Learning
description: Off removes the study bar and makes the tutor tools answer that they are switched off.

heading: Settings
label: Level for new sessions
description: How firmly answers are held back in a new session: Gentle, Firm (default) or Strict. The text under it explains the chosen level.

heading: Settings
label: Ideas per review
description: The most ideas one review session goes through: 5, 10, 15 or 20.

label: Topics
description: Topics studied, shown as Topics (count), with each idea's last result and when it comes back.

heading: Topics
label: Remove
description: On each topic: removes it and its record after you confirm with Yes, remove (Keep cancels).

label: Learning record folder
description: Where the learning record is kept; default is a folder in the dsh home. Only in the configuration file.

label: study-tutor skill
description: Register the study-tutor skill. On by default. Only in the configuration file.

label: Slash command name (/learn)
description: Name of the slash command, default learn; empty registers none. Only in the configuration file.

label: Diagrams
description: Lets the model draw accurate diagrams. It only describes what is in the diagram; layout, drawing and an overlap check are done for it. Nothing leaves this Mac.

label: What it can draw
description: Flowcharts and concept maps, trees and mind maps, sequences, timelines, bar and line charts, and formula plots.

label: Settings
description: The switches, folder and colours for the diagram builder.

heading: Settings
label: Use the diagram builder
description: Off makes the tool answer that it is switched off.

heading: Settings
label: Save each diagram as a file
description: As an SVG picture in the conversation's folder. Off shows it in the chat only.

heading: Settings
label: Folder name
description: The folder inside the conversation's folder that pictures are saved in. Default diagrams.

heading: Settings
label: Colours of the saved file
description: Automatic, Light or Dark. Automatic follows light or dark mode of whatever shows the file. The picture in the chat always matches the app.

label: Good to know
description: Content still needs checking; overlaps found by the check are sent back to the model; click a picture in the chat for full size.

label: draw-diagram skill
description: Register the draw-diagram skill. On by default. Only in the configuration file.

label: Mac
description: Lets the assistant find your files and run your Apple Shortcuts. Nothing is allowed until you allow it here; it uses Spotlight and the Shortcuts app.

label: Finding files
description: Folders where the assistant may search for files by words in the file or its name. It gets the file's place and date, not its contents.

heading: Finding files
label: Remove
description: On each allowed folder: takes it off the list. The folder itself is not touched.

heading: Finding files
label: A folder, for example ~/Documents
description: Type the path of a folder the assistant may search, then press Enter or Add.

heading: Finding files
label: Add
description: Allows file search in the typed folder.

heading: Finding files
label: Choose…
description: Opens the folder chooser to pick a folder the assistant may search.

label: Shortcuts
description: Shortcuts you made in Apple's Shortcuts app. Switch on the ones the assistant may run; it asks each time unless Without asking is also on.

heading: Shortcuts
label: May run
description: On each Shortcut: lets the assistant run it. It asks you each time unless Without asking is also on.

heading: Shortcuts
label: Without asking
description: On each allowed Shortcut: runs it without asking you first. Only for Shortcuts that cannot do harm.

label: Everything
description: The master switch for the Mac bridge.

heading: Everything
label: Use the Mac bridge
description: Off takes file search and Shortcuts away from the assistant. Your choices above are kept.

description: Shortcut safety, names the assistant sees, text treated as data, Spotlight-indexed files only; Mail, Calendar and Reminders are not included yet.

label: DeepSeek Harness
description: The app's own colours, exactly as shipped (stock).

label: MindsHub Cowork
description: Deep navy with teal accents, light and dark.

label: Graphite
description: Neutral greys with amber accents, light and dark.

label: Forest
description: Deep green with mint accents, light and dark.

label: Custom
description: Your own colours from the custom scheme below. Can be picked once a valid custom scheme is saved; shows its own label if it has one.

description: On the Mac desktop app, paint the sidebar in the scheme's colour instead of see-through. Stock keeps the app's own look.

description: Checks the custom scheme JSON and saves it; an invalid one is not saved.

description: Period of the counts shown: 7 days, 30 days, 90 days or Year.

description: Counts model requests and tokens per day and model. Only numbers are stored. Default on.

description: How many days of counts are kept, 1 to 3650. Default 365.

description: Name of the /usage command (/usage reset clears every count). Default usage.

description: Switches the Agent swarm add-on and its run_swarm tool on or off. Default on.

description: Named swarms: description, strategy (fanout, pipeline or debate), rounds, maxActive, maxMinutes, budget and members. This page only lists them.

label: Model prices
description: Dollars per million input and output tokens per route/model, for the dollar figures and budgets. Models not listed count as 0.

label: Default swarm per mode
description: A swarm name per mode id; in that mode a one-line hint about the swarm is added to the system prompt.

description: What a swarm does when a member's route is down: rebind to another route, skip the member, or refuse the run. Default rebind.

description: Switches the Benchmark add-on, its jobs and the /bench command on or off. Default on.

label: Seeds needed for a confident pick
description: A recommendation with fewer seeds than this is marked low confidence and left out of the export, 1 to 50. Default 3.

label: Slash command name
description: Name of the /bench command. Default bench.

label: Data folder
description: Where code maps are kept. Empty uses a folder in the app's data folder.

label: Slash command name
description: Name of the /codemap command. Empty registers no command.

label: Reverse-engineer skills on/off
description: Registers the four reverse-engineer skills (/reverse-codebase, /reverse-website, /reverse-api-format, /reverse-app-binary). Default on.

label: Set up Python for Data
description: The first time Data is switched on, set up Plus's private Python for statistics and charts (about 450 MB). Off leaves data_python not set up.

label: Answer length limit
description: How much longer answers may get before a change is refused; 1.5 means 50% more tokens. 1 to 10, default 1.5.

label: Kind of subject
description: Company, sector, economy or market. Chosen with the drop-down on the Finance tab's start page; the last choice is saved here.

label: Subject
description: The company, sector or economy to research; may be empty. Typed on the Finance tab's start page.

label: Market
description: The market to research. Chosen on the Finance tab's start page. Default Global.

label: Focus
description: What the research concentrates on. Chosen on the Finance tab's start page. Default full.

label: Period
description: How far back to look. Chosen on the Finance tab's start page. Default year.

label: Data folder
description: Where the learning record is kept. Default a folder in the dsh home.

label: Slash command name
description: Name of the /learn command. Empty registers no command.

label: Rescan every N minutes
description: How often the Library folders are checked for new and changed files, in minutes. 0 checks only when asked. Default 10.

label: Arena on/off
description: Switches the Model arena and its /arena command on or off. Default on.

label: Slash command name
description: Name of the /arena command. Default arena.

label: Model profiles
description: Per-model sampling defaults as JSON keyed by provider and model id: label, wireEffort, temperature, maxTokens, enabled. Only a backup import changes it.

label: Model registry migrated
description: One-time marker the app sets after moving model settings to the route-keyed registry. Not meant to be changed.

label: Starters migrated
description: One-time marker: installs from before 0.10 keep their starter names and model defaults. Not meant to be changed.

label: Profile per conversation
description: Per-conversation tier profile choice as JSON, set from the model button in the chat box. Without one, the project's default profile applies.

label: Clean up old conversation entries
description: Once per start, drop per-conversation tier and profile entries whose conversation no longer exists. Default on.

label: Modes added by other add-ons
description: Modes other add-ons add (Finance, Research and others) as JSON in the modes format. Each add-on writes and removes its own entry.

label: Mode for scheduled tasks
description: Mode of a conversation an Automation task opens. An unknown id falls back to the first mode with all tools. Default cowork.

label: Mode per conversation
description: Each conversation's chosen mode as JSON, written by the mode selector in the chat box.

label: Isolated conversations
description: Conversations that began in an isolated mode; they stay isolated whatever happens to the mode. Written by the app.

label: Clean up old conversation entries
description: Once per start, drop per-conversation entries whose conversation is no longer stored. Default on.

label: Keep a conversation's first mode
description: Record the mode a conversation starts in, so a later change of the default mode (for example from a sidebar tab) only affects new ones. Default on.

label: Web switch per conversation
description: Each conversation's web on or off as JSON, set with the Web button in the chat box. Missing uses the mode's default.

label: Deep research per conversation
description: Obsolete: the old per-conversation Deep research switch. No longer offered or read; kept only so older settings files still load.

label: Web level per conversation
description: Each conversation's Web level (quick, standard, thorough or deep) as JSON, set with the Web button in the chat box.

label: Tools switch per conversation
description: Conversations whose tools are switched off, as JSON, set with the Tools button in the chat box. While off, no tool is offered.

label: Web search level
description: How hard the model searches: quick, standard, thorough or deep. Set with the Web button in the chat box; new conversations start there. Default standard.

label: Code working method
description: Give the Code mode a working method (read first, small changes, run the tests, report plainly) while it has no instructions of its own. Default on.

label: Helper models per conversation
description: Each conversation's choice of models for helper agents (same or roles) as JSON, set in the chat box. Without one, the choice on the Research page applies.

label: Slash command name
description: Name of the slash command that switches modes. Default mode.

label: Tool families per conversation
description: Tool families a conversation has loaded (for example pdf, data), as JSON. Written by the app.

label: Old Search-off marks cleared
description: One-time marker (0.55.1): old Search off marks were cleared where Web Off would block a tab's own search tools. Not meant to be changed.

label: Slash command name
description: Name of the /pdf command. Empty registers no command.

label: tor program path
description: Where the tor program is. Empty looks in the usual places (Homebrew, /usr/local). Plus does not install it.

label: Use another .onion search engine
description: Search with another .onion engine instead of the built-in filtered index (Ahmia). The blocklist and word screen apply either way. Default off.

label: Other engine address
description: That engine's .onion name (56 characters and .onion). Used only while the other engine is on.

label: Export folder
description: Where /recon export writes its files. Empty uses recon/exports in the app's home.

label: Old news server
description: The single news server of older versions. Read only to turn it into the first Usenet account.

label: Old news server port
description: That older news server's port, default 563. Read only to turn it into the first Usenet account.

label: Reports folder
description: Where Research tab reports are saved. Empty uses research/reports in the app's home.

label: Sampling presets on/off
description: Switches the Sampling presets add-on and its command on or off. Default on.

label: Slash command name
description: Name of the /sampling command. Default sampling.

label: Job title or kind of work
description: The work to look for, in your words. Typed on the Scout tab's start page; saved here.

label: Location
description: Town, region or remote. Typed on the Scout tab's start page.

label: Pay target
description: The pay you aim for, as you write it. Typed on the Scout tab's start page.

label: Work type
description: Any, employee, freelance, contract, internship or tender. Chosen on the Scout tab's start page. Default any.

label: Scout folder
description: Folder for your files and the saved reports. Empty uses scout/files in the app's home.

label: Code power on/off
description: Switches the Code power skills (PR review, CI fix loop, best-of-N, hunk review) and the judge tool on or off. Default on.

label: PR review lanes
description: Review angles the pr-review skill runs, for example correctness, security, tests, performance. Default correctness, security, tests.

label: Best-of-N attempts
description: How many attempts the best-of-n skill makes in separate worktrees, 2 to 5. Default 3.

label: Judge role
description: Tier role whose model judges the candidates (plan, implement, review or fast). Default review.

label: Judge criteria
description: What the judge scores each candidate on. Default correctness, completeness, simplicity, test coverage.

label: Judge twice in reverse order
description: Repeats the judgement with the candidates in reverse order; different winners give a tie flagged as split. Default on.

label: CI fix rounds
description: Most fix rounds the ci-fix-loop skill runs before it stops and reports, 1 to 50. Default 5.

label: CI check command
description: Command the ci-fix-loop skill runs to check the work, for example make check. Empty: the skill finds or asks for it.

label: Judge tool name
description: Name of the blind judge tool for comparing candidate diffs. Default judge_candidates.

label: Context Saver on/off
description: Shortens large tool results before the model sees them and keeps the originals. Off by default; needs the Python and data folder settings when on.

label: Python interpreter
description: Path of the Python that has dsh-intel-mcp installed. Required when Context Saver is on.

label: Data folder
description: Absolute folder where originals are kept; must equal DSH_INTEL_HOME of the context MCP server. Required when on.

label: Smallest result to shorten
description: Tool results shorter than this many characters are left alone, 500 to 1,000,000. Default 4000.

label: Least saving to keep
description: A shortened result is used only if it is at least this many percent smaller, 1 to 95. Default 15.

label: Tiers to compress
description: Tier ids set to true; when any are listed, only those tiers are compressed (needs Model Tiers). Empty compresses every tier.

label: Tools never shortened
description: Tool names whose results stay verbatim. Default: the file read, write and edit tools, present and ask_user_question.

label: Retrieve tool name
description: Tool the model uses to get an original back; named in the prompt and never compressed. Default mcp__context__context_retrieve.

label: Helper timeout
description: Milliseconds the Python helper may take to shorten a result, 500 to 120000. Default 10000.

label: Prompt note
description: Adds a short system prompt section that explains shortened results and how to retrieve the full text. Default on.

label: Slash command name
description: Name of the command that shows tokens saved today and over 30 days. Default saved.

label: Model router on/off
description: Routes each turn to one of 2 to 5 candidate models using a small routing model. Default on.

label: Candidate models
description: 2 to 5 candidates, each a Tier id or a provider and model, with strengths saying what it is good at. Nothing is preset.

label: Routing model provider
description: Provider route of the small model that picks a candidate for each turn.

label: Routing model
description: Model id of the small routing model.

label: Routing timeout
description: Milliseconds to wait for the routing model; without an answer the current route is kept. 500 to 60000, default 4000.

label: Routing answer length
description: Most tokens the routing model may answer with, 50 to 2000. Default 200.

label: Turns to stay after a switch
description: Turns to stay on a candidate after switching to it, 0 to 50. Default 2. Each switch can discard the server's cache.

label: Minimum confidence
description: A routing answer below this confidence (0 to 1) is ignored. Default 0.6.

label: Default candidate
description: Candidate id to use when the routing answer cannot be used. Empty keeps the current one.

label: Respect route health
description: Leave out candidates whose route the Route health add-on reports as down. Default on.

label: Routing instructions
description: Extra text added to the routing model's instructions. Empty uses only the built-in text.

label: Recent messages shown
description: How many recent messages the routing model sees, 0 to 10. Default 3.

label: Prompt sections
description: Your own system prompt sections: each has text, order, enabled and appliesToTiers (empty applies to every tier).

label: Routes to check
description: Per provider route: probeUrl, label, timeoutMs, slowMs, failureThreshold, reprobeSeconds, intervalSeconds. Nothing is checked until routes are listed.

label: Move off a down route
description: When a route goes down, move its conversations to the next route in the tier's fallback chain. Default on.

label: Move back when it recovers
description: Move conversations back to their own route once it is up again. Default on.

label: Only check routes in use
description: Probe a route only when a live conversation or a tier uses it. Default on.

label: Refuse steps on a down route
description: Refuse a step on a down route with a clear error instead of letting it hang. Default on.

label: Notify on/off
description: Runs a command you choose when a turn ends or dsh needs your approval. Default on.

label: Notification rules
description: Each rule: id, on (turnEnd or approval), reasons, minSeconds, topLevelOnly, minIntervalSeconds, timeoutMs and command (run without a shell).

label: Most runs per minute
description: Most notification commands run per minute across all rules, 1 to 600. Default 20.

label: Media tools on/off
description: Switches the image tools and the approval gate for browser and computer-use tools on or off. Default on.

label: Image API address
description: Base URL of the images API, ending in /v1. Set it together with the image model.

label: Image model
description: Model id the image generate and edit tools use.

label: API key variable
description: Name of the environment variable that holds the image API key: a name, never the key. Leave out for a keyless server.

label: Image service name
description: Name of the image service shown in error messages. Optional.

label: Ask before image calls
description: When to ask before an image call: first (the first time), every time, or never. Default first.

label: Image calls per conversation
description: Most image calls in one conversation, 1 to 200. Default 20.

label: Images per request
description: Most images one generate call may make, 1 to 4. Default 4.

label: Image output folder
description: Folder inside the working folder where images are saved; must be relative. Default generated-images.

label: Accept image links
description: Accept an image URL from the API and download it (public addresses only). Off refuses URL results. Default on.

label: Image timeout
description: Milliseconds an image call may take, 1000 to 1800000. Default 180000.

label: Generate tool name
description: Name of the image generation tool. Default generate_image.

label: Edit tool name
description: Name of the image editing tool. Default edit_image.

label: Tools that need approval
description: Regular expressions of tool names (for example browser or computer-use tools) to ask about before they run.

label: Gate asks
description: Ask the first time a matching tool runs, or every time. Default first.

label: Gate question text
description: Text shown in the approval question. Optional.

label: OpenCode program path
description: Where the OpenCode program is. Empty looks in the usual places. Plus does not install it.

label: Engine time limit
description: The longest an outside engine may work on one task, in minutes. Default 30.

label: OpenCode models to offer
description: OpenCode models offered in the model menu, as provider/model. Also set under Models to offer on the Engines page in the sidebar.

label: When an engine's changes go in
description: review waits for /engine apply, new adds new files at once, auto puts everything in. Also on the Engines page in the sidebar; a Mission mode decides when on.

label: Sync on/off
description: Syncs sessions and the project list between machines through a git remote you choose. Default on.

label: Git remote
description: URL or absolute path of a bare repository. No credentials in it.

label: Branch
description: Git branch used for syncing. Default main.

label: Backend
description: git sends plaintext; encrypted encrypts sessions with age. Default git.

label: Encryption policy
description: optional allows plaintext with a warning; required sends and receives nothing unless age encryption is fully set up. Default optional.

label: age program
description: Name or path of the age program. Default age.

label: age public key
description: Public key (recipient) used to encrypt, for the encrypted backend.

label: age key file
description: Absolute path of the age key file (a path, never the key itself), for the encrypted backend.

label: Session folder
description: Where live sessions are stored. Empty uses the sessions folder in the dsh home.

label: Repository folder
description: Local working copy of the sync repository. Empty uses repo inside the data folder.

label: Device name
description: A name for this machine, shown in project manifests. Optional.

label: Pull on start
description: Pull from the remote when the app starts. Default off.

label: Push after each turn
description: Push after a top-level turn ends, at most once per minimum push interval. Default off.

label: Pull every N minutes
description: Pull on a timer, in minutes, up to 10080; 0 is off. Default 0.

label: Minimum push interval
description: Seconds between automatic pushes, 5 to 86400. Default 60.

label: Sync projects
description: Write this machine's project list into the sync repository and read the other machines' lists. Default off.

label: Add projects automatically
description: After a pull, add other machines' projects whose folder exists here. Off only reports them; /sync projects apply adds them.

label: Folder map
description: Pairs of from (folder prefix on another machine) and to (folder on this one) for project paths.

label: git program
description: Name or path of the git program. Default git.

label: Command timeout
description: Milliseconds one git or age command may run, 1000 to 3600000. Default 120000.

label: Command output limit
description: Most bytes of output kept from one command, 4096 to 16 MB. Default 262144.

label: Commit author name
description: Author name on sync commits. Default dsh-sync.

label: Commit author email
description: Author email on sync commits. Default dsh-sync@localhost.

label: Shared folder
description: Absolute path (or ~/...) of the folder for the shared settings file, such as iCloud Drive. Empty uses the folder the installer recorded, or stays off.

label: Also share
description: Extra entry ids to share, for example ui-theme.

label: Never share
description: Entry ids never to share.

label: Fields not shared
description: Fields kept per Mac, as entry id.field. Default: per-conversation fields such as modes.sessionModes and model-tiers.activeTiers.

label: Check every N seconds
description: How often the shared file is checked, 5 to 3600 seconds. Default 30.

label: Show balance
description: Shows your DeepSeek balance at the bottom of the sidebar. Off takes it away and asks DeepSeek nothing. Default on.

label: Cmd-K opens Global Search
description: Cmd-K (Ctrl-K) opens Global Search. Off leaves that shortcut to the app. Default on.

label: Tab layout
description: JSON per mode: newLabel, pages, greeting and chips. A mode not listed gets a tab with no pages of its own; pages no tab lists show under every tab.

label: Most tabs
description: At most this many tabs at the top of the sidebar (the first modes in order), 1 to 5. Default 3.

label: Hide DeepSeek logos
description: Hides the logo and name at the top of the sidebar and the logo on the start page. Also in the sidebar's More menu. Default off.

label: Show the date as the title
description: The start page title shows today's date instead of the tab's greeting. Also in the sidebar's More menu. Default off.

label: Wide chat area
description: The conversation and message box use the whole window width instead of a centred column. Also in the sidebar's More menu. Default off.

label: Deep research on/off
description: Switches the deep_research tool on or off. Default on.

label: Tool name
description: Name of the research tool the model calls. Default deep_research.

label: Planner role
description: Tier role that plans the research (plan, implement, review or fast); the analyst uses it too. Default plan.

label: Searcher role
description: Tier role of the helpers that search and read (plan, implement, review or fast). Default fast.

label: Writer role
description: Tier role that writes the report (plan, implement, review or fast). Default plan.

label: Helper model without Modes
description: same (the conversation's model) or roles (Tier role models). Used only when the Modes add-on is not there. Default same.

label: Depth without Modes
description: quick, standard or thorough. Used only when the Modes add-on is not there to say. Default standard.

label: Most sub-questions
description: Upper bound on the sub-questions a run plans, 1 to 12; the chosen depth is held to it. Default 8.

label: Most helpers at once
description: Upper bound on helpers searching at once, 1 to 8. Default 8.

label: Most sources
description: Upper bound on the sources one run collects, 1 to 200. Default 120.

label: Most minutes
description: Upper bound on the minutes one run may take, 1 to 240. Default 60.

label: Search tool names
description: Tools the helpers search with. Default web_search; use other names for another search backend, such as an MCP one.

label: Page reading tool names
description: Tools the helpers read pages with. Default web_fetch.

label: Only use pages really read
description: Drop findings whose source page was not actually fetched. Default off.

label: Wide mode rows
description: Most rows in a wide (table and CSV) run, 1 to 5000. Default 500.

label: Settings search on/off
description: Off hides this search field in the Settings window header. Default on.
